migrations.sql:
-- Identity providers (OpenID Connect). Apply as a NEW numbered migration after
-- the accounts schema. Every statement is IF NOT EXISTS, so a store that applied
-- an earlier version of this file applies the current one again as its next
-- migration and gains only what it lacks.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions (
  state_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  binding_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  config_hash TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_transactions_expiry ON oa_oidc_transactions(expires_at);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_oidc_limits (
  bucket TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  count INTEGER NOT NULL,
  expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);
-- One pinned link per configured provider. Linking stores the issuer, JWKS URI,
-- client id, endpoints and allowed algorithms; a changed configuration only
-- records a pending re-link, which the owner completes with a step-up proof.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_providers (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  preset TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('linked','unlinked')),
  issuer TEXT NOT NULL,
  client_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  jwks_uri TEXT NOT NULL,
  authorization_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_endpoint TEXT NOT NULL,
  algorithms TEXT NOT NULL,
  token_auth_method TEXT NOT NULL,
  response_iss INTEGER NOT NULL,
  interface_version TEXT,
  linked_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  pending_issuer TEXT,
  pending_client_id TEXT,
  pending_preset TEXT,
  pending_at INTEGER,
  jwks TEXT,
  jwks_fetched_at INTEGER
);
-- Reachability per configured provider, linked or not. A provider that has
-- failed discovery or JWKS for 5 minutes, or answered 404 or a DNS failure, is
-- hidden from the sign-in page until a later check succeeds.
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS oa_identity_provider_health (
  provider_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  failing_since INTEGER,
  hard_failure_at INTEGER,
  checked_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

-- SAFE-001. Terrace's own second factor: one sealed TOTP secret per operator (confirmed once a code matches, with
-- the last accepted step so a code is never accepted twice), single-use recovery codes stored as SHA-256 hashes,
-- the sign-in sessions that passed it, wrong-code attempts for the lockout, and the owner's switch requiring a second
-- factor for everyone signing in by email link. None of these except the switch is archived.

CREATE TABLE tt_factor_sessions (session_hash TEXT PRIMARY KEY, operator_id TEXT NOT NULL, method TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(method IN ('totp','recovery')), verified_at TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE tt_factor_failures (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, operator_id TEXT NOT NULL, at TEXT NOT NULL);

-- ACCT-016. Utility recovery and taxable ancillary charges. A utility bill is recorded per property with its source
-- invoice, the recoverable share, an allocation formula and an optional per-lease cap; a second person approves the
-- exact allocation, which posts one charge per lease that authorizes recovery of that utility. Tax rules per
-- property and charge kind take effect only once an accountant (or the owner) has reviewed them; a tax charge names
-- its rule and is never owner income.
CREATE TABLE tt_recovery_authorizations (
 tenancy_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tt_tenancies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 utility TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(utility IN ('water','sewer','trash','gas','electric')),
 reference TEXT NOT NULL, recorded_by TEXT NOT NULL, recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(tenancy_id,utility)
);
CREATE TABLE tt_utility_bills (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 property_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tt_properties(id),
 utility TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(utility IN ('water','sewer','trash','gas','electric')),
 vendor TEXT NOT NULL, invoice_reference TEXT NOT NULL,
 period_start TEXT NOT NULL, period_end TEXT NOT NULL, due_date TEXT NOT NULL,
 amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(amount_cents>0),
 recoverable_bp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(recoverable_bp BETWEEN 0 AND 10000),
 formula TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(formula IN ('occupants','bedrooms','equal','submeter')),
 readings TEXT, cap_cents INTEGER CHECK(cap_cents IS NULL OR cap_cents>0),
 state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'prepared' CHECK(state IN ('prepared','approved')),
 fingerprint TEXT, prepared_by TEXT NOT NULL, prepared_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 approved_by TEXT, approved_at TEXT, approval_label TEXT,
 UNIQUE(property_id,invoice_reference)
);
CREATE TABLE tt_utility_allocations (
 bill_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tt_utility_bills(id),
 tenancy_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tt_tenancies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 basis INTEGER NOT NULL, basis_label TEXT NOT NULL,
 amount_cents INTEGER NOT NULL, capped INTEGER NOT NULL,
 charge_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(bill_id,tenancy_id)
);
CREATE TABLE tt_tax_rules (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 property_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tt_properties(id),
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('utility','parking','storage','other')),
 rate_bp INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(rate_bp BETWEEN 1 AND 10000),
 label TEXT NOT NULL, starts TEXT NOT NULL,
 prepared_by TEXT NOT NULL, prepared_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 reviewed_by TEXT, reviewed_at TEXT,
 UNIQUE(property_id,kind,starts)
);
ALTER TABLE tt_charges ADD COLUMN tax_rule_id TEXT;
-- ACCT-011 x ACCT-009: a closed month takes no new fee lines either.
CREATE TRIGGER tt_fee_period BEFORE INSERT ON tt_fees WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tt_period_closes WHERE month=NEW.month AND reopened_at IS NULL) BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'period_closed'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER tt_allocation_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON tt_utility_allocations BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'An allocation is never edited'); END;
CREATE TRIGGER tt_tax_rule_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON tt_tax_rules WHEN OLD.reviewed_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.kind<>OLD.kind OR NEW.rate_bp<>OLD.rate_bp OR NEW.starts<>OLD.starts OR NEW.property_id<>OLD.property_id OR NEW.label<>OLD.label BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'A tax rule is never edited'); END;

-- OPS-003: persistent workflow templates and runs. A template version is immutable; a run keeps the version it started
-- under. Every transition appends a sequenced, never-edited event, and the run row keeps the durable next action, so a
-- restart resumes from D1 alone. Terrace performs no outbound contact: attempts and replies are staff-recorded.
CREATE TABLE tt_workflow_templates (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 template_key TEXT NOT NULL,
 version INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(version > 0),
 name TEXT NOT NULL,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('leasing','renewal','rent','delinquency','unit_turn')),
 trigger TEXT NOT NULL,
 conditions TEXT NOT NULL,
 steps TEXT NOT NULL,
 contact_limit INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK(contact_limit BETWEEN 1 AND 10),
 escalate_to TEXT NOT NULL,
 reference TEXT NOT NULL,
 retired_at TEXT,
 retired_by TEXT,
 created_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(template_key,version)
);
CREATE TRIGGER tt_workflow_template_immutable BEFORE UPDATE OF template_key,version,name,kind,trigger,conditions,steps,contact_limit,escalate_to,reference,created_by,created_at ON tt_workflow_templates BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'A template change appends a version'); END;
CREATE TABLE tt_workflow_runs (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 template_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tt_workflow_templates(id),
 template_key TEXT NOT NULL,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL,
 subject_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(subject_kind IN ('prospect','renewal','tenancy','turnover')),
 subject_id TEXT NOT NULL,
 tenancy_id TEXT REFERENCES tt_tenancies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 unit_id TEXT,
 portfolio_id TEXT,
 label TEXT NOT NULL,
 zone TEXT NOT NULL,
 state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'running' CHECK(state IN ('running','paused','escalated','completed','closed','cancelled')),
 step_index INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 step_started_on TEXT NOT NULL,
 step_due_on TEXT NOT NULL,
 assignee TEXT,
 contacts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 awaiting INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(awaiting IN (0,1)),
 pause_reason TEXT,
 escalation_reason TEXT,
 escalated_to TEXT,
 next_action TEXT,
 authority_operator TEXT NOT NULL,
 authority_role TEXT NOT NULL,
 authority_version INTEGER NOT NULL,
 version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
 started_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 ended_at TEXT,
 CHECK(state<>'paused' OR pause_reason IS NOT NULL),
 CHECK(state<>'escalated' OR (escalation_reason IS NOT NULL AND escalated_to IS NOT NULL)),
 CHECK(state IN ('completed','closed','cancelled') OR next_action IS NOT NULL),
 CHECK((state IN ('completed','closed','cancelled'))=(ended_at IS NOT NULL))
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX tt_workflow_live ON tt_workflow_runs(template_key,subject_kind,subject_id) WHERE state IN ('running','paused','escalated');
CREATE INDEX tt_workflow_subject ON tt_workflow_runs(subject_kind,subject_id);
CREATE INDEX tt_workflow_tenancy ON tt_workflow_runs(tenancy_id);
CREATE TABLE tt_workflow_events (
 id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
 run_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tt_workflow_runs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 tenancy_id TEXT REFERENCES tt_tenancies(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 sequence INTEGER NOT NULL,
 kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(kind IN ('started','step_done','attempt','reconciled','reply','paused','resumed','escalated','escalation_resolved','completed','cancelled')),
 step_index INTEGER NOT NULL,
 detail TEXT NOT NULL,
 reference TEXT NOT NULL,
 label TEXT NOT NULL,
 recorded_by TEXT NOT NULL,
 recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(run_id,sequence)
);
CREATE TRIGGER tt_workflow_event_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON tt_workflow_events BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'Workflow history is never edited'); END;

 SELECT 1 FROM tt_resident_deliveries d WHERE d.provider=NEW.provider
 AND d.recipient=json_extract(NEW.event_json,'$.recipients[0]')
 AND (d.id=json_extract(NEW.event_json,'$.deliveryId') OR
 (json_extract(NEW.event_json,'$.deliveryId') IS NULL AND d.provider_id=json_extract(NEW.event_json,'$.providerMessageId')))
)
